paragraphs.text:
Norman  finally  speaks.  “What  will  we  do  now,  Professor?” 
Sylvia,  her  face  lit  by  flickering  flames,  looks  at  you  like  a 
hopeful orphan.

Charlie is gone. But of course, you cannot abandon Bernard 
whilst there is a chance of finding him alive. At that moment, a 
clear cry rings from above. You look to the sky.

“My feet! My flaming feet! My heart!” The plaintive call cuts 
off  abruptly  and  you  hear  something  heavy  crashing  down 
through the treetops, breaking branches as it plummets.

You tell the others to get their guns. You stand over the fire, a 
nervous finger on your trigger. Hours pass. Finally, a twig snaps. 
Then another. Unhurried, something steps from the bush.

To shoot at the first sight of the figure, go to 138. To let it come closer, 
go to 101.
